description: Head and torso hold position; only the mouth shape and eye pupils change tile to tile (mouth open ellipse at f21/f22/f23, flatter at f24); detector peak value is small (1.65).
Banners, columns and carpet edges shift position between tiles and the throne grows slightly, consistent with a slow push-in or reframing; the seated character does not visibly move.
Seated character tilted while the hand with extended finger sits at right; little change among these three tiles.
At f327 the throne and hand appear larger and shifted versus f326 (columns and window larger), a sudden reframing rather than a gradual one.
Character is flicked off the throne: tilted off the seat at f328, rotated and moving left at f329, nearly gone at the left edge at f330; the hand stays at right with the finger extended.
Character has left frame by f331 leaving an empty throne and the hand held in place.
The peasant lies sideways near the path and the cottage and castle remain; only very small shifts (a slight scale change of the cottage) are visible across tiles.
Empty room with window and posts; no bed yet.
Sack bed enters from the top edge at f530, moves down and left through f531-f532, then back right to settle on the floor by f534-f535 (path read from tile positions).
Barrel with a bowl and the shelf unit drop in from the top at f555, move down and settle to the right of the bed and ring by f562; the bed and stone ring are already in place at f555.
Goat on white moves left across the frame; it is mostly cropped by f789.
Goat exits left; only a sliver remains at f790.
Hand-lettered word 'maybe' is already fully formed at f790 with no visible partial letters in the sampled tiles.
Room with the peasant and animals and no label at f854; a tiny scribble-like mark appears at f855 where the label will go.
White 'dirt' word and arrow appear: tiny mark at f855, then full word and arrow at f856, so the reveal takes about 2 tile frames.
Label and scene hold unchanged.
Tiles are near-identical; the scene may darken or add haze slightly across the strip but no object motion is discernible at 480x270.
Wall tone and sky-through-gap tint brighten from pale cyan to near white across the 8 tiles; window geometry unchanged.
Day sky blends to dark blue night across the 8 tiles; grass dims.
Moon appears at f1372 behind small cottage, rises up and right by f1377.
Burlap sack slides in from right edge over the arrow label by f1568.
Label Straw and arrow turn grey and disappear as sack covers them.
Large dark tick moves left and exits frame; fleas remain.
Straw layout looks rescaled between f1656 and f1657 (larger stalks to smaller); cut vs scale move not resolved.
Small flea position shifts a few pixels; background static.
Man rotates from lying to upright and rises out of bed; stick arms appear by f1842.
Standing man head tilts and returns upright, mouth shape varies.
Camera moves right; old woman exits left, arched doorway enters from right.
Push-in toward bald man; background blurs.
Word privacy replaced by word is.
Camera moves right; bald man enters from right edge and slime-faced man exits left.
Background and inset picture appear static; narrator torso/body position and visible chest region vary slightly across tiles. Magnitude not measured.
"no chimney" appears low behind roof at f2833 and rises to final position by f2835; absent at f2832.
Red X appears small on chimney at f2837 and grows to full size by f2839.
Close roof view zooms out to full cottage with door and shutter; smoke wisp shrinks with it. Pan component not distinguishable.
Left stick arm sweeps upward from low-left to above head; green cloud wobbles at mouth; head tilts.
Armpit illustration is absent f3187-3189 and present from f3190; dog constant throughout. No in-between frame seen.
All four items shrink and move toward the centre into a small clump by f3296. Cannot distinguish per-item animation from uniform zoom-out of a composite.
Mouth shape and pupil position change across tiles; body, sacks and walls static.
Plate photo absent f3631-3633, present from f3634 at final size; header and caption static.
Second character at bottom-left changes position/crop across tiles; main villager near static; scene shows small horizontal drift. Interpretation uncertain.
Board text and classroom static; only subtle narrator head/mouth variation (measured diff 3.63).
Left plate and its caption tilt and rise out of the top of frame; gone by f4196.
Left stick arm swings from level to raised up-left after plate leaves.

Roots-on-soil pile slides rightward off frame: center x about 1046, 1200, 1420, 1640 (full-res, from 4x tile) for f4257-f4260 and clipped at the right edge in f4261; spacing grows frame to frame (accelerating exit, spacing INFERRED).

Mouse slides in from the left edge: faint patch at f4258, tail at f4259, head at edge f4260, then x about 200-790, 420-1000, 580-1160, 660-1240 for f4261-4264; steps shrink, so it decelerates into center (spacing INFERRED).

Bald bearded man's head moves left into frame at the right edge, about 100 px full-res over 7 frames, with changing mouth and eye shapes; cauldron, stump, shelf and posts are static in all eight tiles.
Flame under the cauldron changes silhouette between tiles (flicker); no scale or position change of the pot (left edge about 920 vs 912 full-res).
Man's head shifts right about 80 px full-res and tilts while mouth shape changes; scenery static; a small orange straw tuft at the right edge is steady.

Board image panel grows vertically from a thin horizontal band (about 60 px tall full-res at f4596) through ~120, ~280 to full height (~500 px) at f4599 with constant width (~950 px); band appears translucent at first; previous image not visible in any tile.
Image panel, narrator, pointer, projector and poster hold steady (only sub-few-pixel differences at this tile scale).
The word "invented" holds unchanged at the same position for three tiles.

Hard swap from "invented" (about 470 px wide) to the smaller word "yet" (about 185 px wide) between f4871 and f4872 with no visible in-between tile; same vertical center; the new word then holds f4872-4876.
Man's head sways left-right and bobs slightly across tiles with mouth shape changes; eyes appear as thin lines in f4943 (blink, from a low-res tile); bowl, bread and spoon stay put.
Black crack lines on the tabletop right of the bread look absent in the f4936 tile and present from f4937 onward while the bread is already present at f4936 (low-res; verify at native).
Weapon rack scene is static with no bread on the rack.

Bread loaf is present at the rack's right end from f5064 (absent f5063) at the same position and size in all later tiles; no intermediate scale or slide tile seen, so entry takes at most one frame step at this sampling.
Title, flour mound, plus sign and tan pile hold position; no third pile yet.
Brown chip pile appears to the right of the tan pile at f5354 (absent at f5353) at full size and at the same position through f5358; other items static.

Skull sign drops in from above the frame onto the flour mound: pole end at about y 132, 272, 412, 560 (full-res) for f5596-5599, roughly 140 px per frame, planted in the mound at f5599; flour mound, label and arrow static.
Sign stays planted; no visible bounce, differences of about 2 tile px (about 8 px) or less.

Board picture squashes vertically to a thin sliver (f5865-f5867) and re-expands (f5868-f5869) as a different painterly picture (deathbed with praying woman); narrator and room static. Squash-and-swap picture transition.
Water glass icon appears at right at f5946 and moves leftward to sit beside "drinks ?" by ~f5949; text static.
Wooden mug falls/slides in from upper right (f5971-f5973) and settles beside bread by f5974; man head tilts/eye direction changes.
Man head tilt and gaze shift across tiles (looking down-right at f5973-f5974, forward by f5976-f5977).
Speech bubble appears small and greyed at f6153, becomes full black outline and larger by f6155 with text "looks fine to me"; stays through f6159.
Bubble opacity ramps up over about f6153-f6155 (grey to black); text appears with it.
Background and overlays shift/scale slightly across tiles (town and trees move a few px); labels drift down/right, "parasites" label fades.
"parasites" label and arrow dim progressively toward f6303.
Label "diarrhea" and brown blob icon shrink/dim toward f6367 while the half-submerged man sinks lower in frame.
Floating man moves slightly downward/bobs across tiles.
Board picture squash-and-expand: thin sliver at f6569-f6570, expands to parchment panel with pot at f6571-f6572; picture swap.
Two purple germ icons appear above pot and rise slightly; steam wisps present by f6572.
Glass beer mug and wooden mug sprites enter from sides in alternating tiles (f6625-f6627); "middle ages" sign appears at top at f6630-f6631. Tiles overlap in the strip, ordering partly ambiguous.
Alternation between glass-mug and wooden-mug images between adjacent tiles could be a rapid compare/cut; cannot be separated from tile overlap.
Alternating views of glass mug "5% alcohol" and wooden mug "~1% alcohol" across f6707-f6710; ordering partly ambiguous due to tile overlap.
Glass mug and labels leave; by f6711 only the wooden mug remains centred (f6711-f6714 static).
Man holds mug on extended arm; head tilt and mouth shape change; mug/arm shifts slightly up/down across tiles.
Mug is gone; arm extended, head tilts and mouth opens/closes; slight whole-scene drift.
Sweat drop on forehead fades by f7245; another drop appears by the beard at f7249.
Spear grows/pierces into torso from f7246 and is nearly full length by f7249.
Thought bubble with bowl fades in at upper right from f7324, bowl progressively darker by f7331; man gaze moves upward.
Man and spear shift left and shrink across tiles (zoom-out / reposition), most visible f7324 to f7328.
Wooden signpost descends from top: pole only at f7522-f7523, sign board visible at f7524, settled on table by f7525 with slight vertical bobbing to f7529.
